paths.description: Homepage and high-volume video listing. Represents entry, global navigation, search and listing cards.
Category index. Represents taxonomy and alternate browse navigation.
Representative video detail and playback template, including player, related content, ads and metadata.
Search results for a neutral query. Represents search and empty/result-state handling.
Direct login endpoint and account-entry form. Represents authentication and form assistance.
Unknown route. Represents HTTP 404 and recovery navigation.

findings.summary: No system-driven dark theme
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() support; the dark-emulated capture is visually identical to the default capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide system-driven light and dark surface tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Animated third-party media ignores reduced motion
findings.evidence: The page ships a 367,766-byte animated GIF while CSS inspection found no prefers-reduced-motion branch; the reduced-motion preference cannot suppress that animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the GIF with controllable media or static fallback and disable non-essential animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route changes have no transition continuity
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition usage even though the site is an MPA with repeated listing-to-detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a progressive fallback for listing-to-detail navigation.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-state-aware navigation
findings.evidence: The homepage is 9,470 CSS pixels tall at 360px width, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, progress indicator or responsive sticky state.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or scroll-state-aware compact navigation treatment for long listing pages.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visibly carry attention between states
findings.evidence: The MPA uses abrupt route swaps and CSS inspection found no view-transition or highlight/scroll-marker treatment to show where context moved.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional cross-document transitions and persistent active navigation state to preserve orientation.

findings.summary: Opaque full-screen age gate blocks every audited public path
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures of home, categories, detail and 404 show a full-screen third-party AgeVerif gate. The only action is the vague label “Start”, with no visible age threshold, privacy explanation or alternate path.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep required age assurance, but present a first-party, accessible explanation of eligibility, data use and next step before invoking a third party.

findings.summary: Overlays rely on custom third-party and Fancybox structures
findings.evidence: The blocking age gate is not exposed in the main DOM as a dialog, and login links rely on a custom Fancybox AJAX fragment rather than a resilient dialog or full page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for the modal gate and a complete login page as fallback, progressively enhanced into a dialog.

findings.summary: Ads and gate chrome crowd out the core detail experience
findings.evidence: The detail DOM places multiple ad-like cards before key player actions, while screenshots show the age gate consuming the full viewport before content.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential promotions until after the core player and clearly separate advertising from content controls.

findings.summary: Components adapt only through page-level responsive CSS
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container or container-type usage across reusable listing and navigation components.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt size container queries for cards and navigation where they are reused in different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly styled
findings.evidence: The focus probe reported outline-style none and no box-shadow for navigation, search and listing links, so keyboard users cannot reliably see focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring with sufficient offset to all interactive controls.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow on primary templates
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.9s on home and 4.9s on detail, both above the 2.5s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the true LCP resource, defer gate/ad scripts and lazy-load below-fold listing media.

findings.summary: Video detail has severe mobile layout shift
findings.evidence: The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.7106 on the detail page, with a single 0.70875 shift at about 3.67s.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve stable dimensions for the player, ads and late content; do not insert gate or ad UI above existing content.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is delayed by third-party and eager media work
findings.evidence: HAR shows a high-priority parser-inserted AgeVerif script, 1.46MB transferred on home, and detail video preload=auto before user intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical third-party scripts, set player preload to metadata or none, and prioritise only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Third-party code dominates script transfer
findings.evidence: The home HAR includes 166,798 bytes of tag-manager JavaScript plus ad and age-verification scripts; detail transfers 355,174 script bytes before playback intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove low-value third parties, load ads after consent and interaction, and conditionally load player code only on detail pages.

findings.summary: Key controls and frames lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports untitled iframes; DOM probes find an unlabeled search input, an empty logo link, and empty links on the detail page.
findings.suggestedFix: Label search, title every iframe, give image-only links accessible names, and verify player controls through the accessibility tree.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 5 contrast failures on home and 12 on detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Update text, metadata, link and control colors to meet WCAG AA in every visual state.

findings.summary: Landmark and focus structure is incomplete
findings.evidence: Both Lighthouse runs report no main landmark, and the focus probe shows outline none for core links and search.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main, retain the existing nav landmark, and add visible :focus-visible treatment in logical tab order.

findings.summary: Video has no captions or equivalent track
findings.evidence: The representative detail page video has no track elements. Mobile reflow itself has no horizontal overflow, but the core media lacks a caption equivalent.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide synchronized captions via track kind=captions and a transcript for each video.

findings.summary: Direct login is an incomplete HTML fragment and detail assets lack stable sizing
findings.evidence: Direct /login/ has no doctype, title, language, viewport or styles. The detail image audit found 34 images without dimensions and Lighthouse found a low-resolution image.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve login as a complete semantic document, then progressively enhance it into a modal; add intrinsic dimensions and responsive sources to detail images.

findings.summary: DevTools issues and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse logged an inspector issue and three back/forward cache failure reasons on both home and detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the reported inspector issue and BFCache blockers, then retest route back/forward navigation.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 2 non-crawlable links on home and 6 on detail even though the pages otherwise render server-side.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real destination href values for every navigation/action link and progressively enhance in-page behavior.

findings.summary: Homepage omits an explicit canonical URL
findings.evidence: The homepage metadata probe found no rel=canonical, while the sitemap and robots file otherwise expose public indexing routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical to the homepage and verify canonical consistency across listing templates.

findings.summary: Homepage has no structured or social metadata
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata for a public content platform.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate WebSite/Organization and content-level VideoObject JSON-LD plus Open Graph preview tags matching visible content.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing. All 8 observed cookies were flagged insecure, including PHPSESSID without Secure or HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark session/auth cookies Secure, HttpOnly and appropriately SameSite.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party footprint is excessive before user choice
findings.evidence: The tracker probe observed 10 third-party origins, Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. HAR also shows age-verification, advertising and analytics requests on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise third parties, gate non-essential analytics/ads behind informed consent, shorten retention and batch only necessary events.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks modern credential semantics
findings.evidence: The login form exposes username/password fields with no autocomplete tokens and no WebAuthn/passkey path; Lighthouse found no permission prompts on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username/current-password immediately, then offer passkey sign-in and registration with password fallback.

findings.summary: Login deep links fail as complete pages
findings.evidence: Navigating directly to /login/ returns an unstyled AJAX fragment with no document metadata or responsive viewport, despite being exposed as a real href.
findings.suggestedFix: Make every linked URL a complete resilient page, and enhance it into a modal only when JavaScript and styling are available.

findings.summary: Age-gate and ad actions are not transparent
findings.evidence: The age gate offers only “Start” without eligibility or data-use context. On detail, ad-like cards have self-referencing hrefs, implying JavaScript interception rather than honest destinations.
findings.suggestedFix: State what the age check does before activation, disclose data recipients, label ads, and use honest destination URLs without click interception.

findings.summary: Login fields lack native error-prevention semantics
findings.evidence: Username and password are visually marked required by class, but both inputs have required=false, so the browser cannot prevent or explain empty submission.
findings.suggestedFix: Add required and appropriate constraints, validate after interaction, and announce actionable errors with aria-describedby/live regions.

findings.summary: Search and login omit autocomplete tokens
findings.evidence: The search field and login username/password inputs all expose empty autocomplete values.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=search where appropriate, username for identity, and current-password for the password field.

findings.summary: Account entry is brittle and offers no phishing-resistant option
findings.evidence: The login endpoint is an unstyled fragment on direct navigation and offers only password authentication with no passkey or reauthentication path.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a complete, reversible account flow and add passkey authentication and reauthentication while retaining recovery options.

findings.summary: Listing images are eager, legacy and non-responsive
findings.evidence: Home has 80 images: 72 below-fold images are not lazy, 80 lack srcset, 33 are oversized, and none use a modern format. Detail has 63 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add srcset/sizes and intrinsic dimensions, and lazy-load all below-fold thumbnails.

findings.summary: Below-fold media and analytics load before user intent
findings.evidence: The homepage eagerly loads 72 below-fold images and analytics/ad requests; the detail player uses preload=auto before playback.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritise below-fold fetches, set video preload to metadata or none, and start analytics/ad work only after consent and need.

findings.summary: Third-party media and scripts consume a disproportionate budget
findings.evidence: Home transfers 1.46MB across 56 requests, includes a 367KB animated GIF, and contacts 10 third-party origins before the core task.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/media budget, remove the animated ad asset, defer promotions, and cache or self-host essential static dependencies.

taskList.title: Make the age-assurance and ad experience transparent, first-party and accessible
Secure cookies and deploy CSP plus defensive response policies
Minimise and consent-gate third-party tracking, ads and analytics
Fix keyboard focus, landmarks, names, contrast and media captions
Eliminate detail-page layout shift and improve LCP discovery
Optimise responsive media and stop eager below-fold fetching
Serve a complete resilient login page with validation and autofill
Add passkey authentication and safer account reauthentication
Replace intercepted links with crawlable, honest destinations and add metadata
Reduce JavaScript/platform debt and restore BFCache
Add system preferences and modern responsive component styling
Improve state continuity for long listings and route changes
